scriptText:
I. PART 1

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a deadpan comedy scene on a desert roadside, featuring @UMA as Mark, @ROBERT as Robert, @ROSA as Rosa, @LEA as Lea, and @EVAN as the Cop, negotiating the custody of a single pineapple.
[[/INTENT]]
[[LOGIC]]
Maintain strict spatial continuity along the shoulder of the road with the station wagon as a stable background anchor. Keep the pineapple physically held in both of the Cop's hands across cuts. Preserve the flat, unblinking expressions and minimal physical gestures to protect the deadpan comedic timing.
[[/LOGIC]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Style: Flat, off-center realist road-movie. Muted, dusty tones.
Light: Soft overcast daylight, warm skin tones, contrasting yellow pineapple.
Environment: Desert road shoulder, dry scrubland, low mesas, grey-blue sky.
Sound: Diegetic only. Dry wind, gravel crunches, sighs, highway drone. No music.
Wardrobe: Mark wearing pale yellow polo, dark glasses, khaki shorts; Robert wearing orange-teal palm shirt, sand trousers, red aviators; Rosa wearing oversized denim jacket, striped top, yellow hairclip; Lea wearing olive utility vest, rust-orange shirt; Cop wearing khaki sheriff uniform, campaign hat, duty belt.
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[OPENING]]
WS, flat frontal lineup. Mark, Robert, Rosa, and Lea stand left-to-right against a dusty station wagon parked on a gravel shoulder. Opposite them, the Cop stands center-left in profile, holding a bright yellow pineapple in both hands.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
WS, low-angle slow push in -> Cop stands center-left facing the group -> Cop holds the pineapple in both hands and exhales slowly -> [ENV] Dry wind
ECU, locked-off -> Close-up of the pineapple in Cop's hands -> Cop's thumbs slightly shift their grip -> [ENV] Heat shimmer rises in the background
MCU, low angle -> Facing the Cop -> Cop tips his chin up a degree with formal authority -> COP: "This was in the vehicle."
POV, slow lateral track left-to-right -> Scanning across Mark, Robert, Rosa, and Lea -> The four travelers stare blankly -> COP (O.S.): "Front seat or back seat."
MCU -> Rosa leaning back against the car hood -> Rosa shifts her weight and picks at her denim sleeve -> ROSA: "Back."
MCU -> Facing the Cop -> Cop takes one slow step forward, maintaining his grip on the pineapple, and sighs -> COP: "Back seat. Whose is it."
MS -> Mark and Robert side-by-side -> Robert tilts his head; Mark raises one index finger slightly and swallows hard -> [ENV] Quiet hum of the wind
MCU, slight high angle -> Facing Lea -> Lea keeps her arms crossed -> LEA: "It's a good pineapple." -> COP (O.S.): "...Thank you, ma'am."
CU -> Facing Robert -> Robert gives one slow, meaningless nod, his beard catching the warm overcast light -> [ENV] Silence, wind rustle
WS, locked-off wide shot -> Entire lineup of the group and the Cop opposite them -> Everyone remains completely motionless in deadpan silence under the vast grey sky -> [ENV] A single tumbleweed rolls slowly across the empty asphalt road in the foreground
[</BRIEF>]

II. PART 2

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a continuation of the deadpan comedy scene on a desert highway, featuring @UMA as Mark, @ROBERT as Robert, @ROSA as Rosa, @LEA as Lea, and @EVAN as the Cop, as they continue their flat-affect confrontation over a pineapple.
[[/INTENT]]
[[LOGIC]]
Match the visual style, pacing, and camera height from @PREVIOUS_CLIP. Preserve exact character styling, hair, and spatial relationships of the lineup against the station wagon.
[[/LOGIC]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Sound: Foley only. Dry wind, gravel crunches, heavy sighs, highway hum. No music.
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[VISUAL BLOCKING]]
The scene opens from the wide establishing shot established at the end of @PREVIOUS_CLIP, with the Cop standing frame-left holding the pineapple in both hands facing the four travelers lined up frame-right against the brown station wagon. Throughout this sequence, the Cop maintains his position on the left-side axis, occasionally pacing and stepping forward, while the travelers remain static on the right.
[[/VISUAL BLOCKING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
Continue from @PREVIOUS_CLIP
MCU, SLOW PUSH -> Cop center-left facing right -> Cop rolls shoulders back, settling grip on pineapple -> COP: "Was it purchased?"
MCU -> Robert facing left -> Robert lifts head slightly, red lenses flashing once, then lowers gaze back toward the pineapple -> ROBERT: (deadpan) "Technically."
MCU -> Cop facing right -> Cop shifts weight foot-to-foot, exhaling a long, quiet breath through his nose -> [SFX] Heavy nasal exhale, gravel crunch
WS -> Cop walks right, pacing slowly before the lineup -> Cop carries pineapple out in both hands, pacing slowly -> COP: "Who made the purchase?"
MCU, SLIGHT PUSH -> Mark -> Mark raises his index finger another inch, parting his dry lips -> MARK: "If I could just—" -> ROSA (O.S.): (monotone) "Mark."
MCU -> Rosa next to Robert -> Rosa closes her eyes without turning her head 
MCU -> Mark -> Mark closes his mouth, lowering his chin; finger remains raised -> [ENV] Wind rustling
MS, SLIGHT HANDHELD -> Cop facing group -> [SFX] Sunglasses clattering on dry earth
MCU -> Cop steps directly in front of Rosa -> Cop staring intensely but calmly at Rosa with bare eyes -> COP: "Ma'am. Do you know something about this pineapple?"
MCU -> Rosa facing slightly left -> Rosa looks at Cop, glances briefly at pineapple, then looks back toward horizon with a slow breath -> ROSA: "No."
WS, static -> Full lineup including Cop on left -> Cop lets out a heavy, defeated sigh; Mark slowly lowers his raised finger while Lea shrugs -> [ENV] Low whistle of desert wind, distant highway engine hum
[</BRIEF>]

III. PART 3

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a continuation of the deadpan desert highway comedy scene, featuring @UMA as Mark, @ROBERT as Robert, @ROSA as Rosa, @LEA as Lea, and @EVAN as the Cop.
[[/INTENT]]
[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Directly continue from @PREVIOUS_CLIP. Match the exact muted-color palette, soft overcast lighting, and dusty desert texture. Ensure precise continuity of character wardrobe, positions, and flat expressions: Cop stands left of Rosa, holding the pineapple, while Mark, Robert, Rosa, and Lea remain lined up from left to right.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
[[VISUAL BLOCKING]]
The scene opens with a wide shot showing the Cop standing close to Rosa on the gravel shoulder, holding the pineapple in both hands, while the four travelers stand in a line against the brown station wagon on the right. Throughout the scene, the Cop paces slowly, while the travelers remain physically static.
[[/VISUAL BLOCKING]]
[[AESTHETIC]]
Sound: Foley only. Dry wind, gravel crunches, deep sighs, fly buzzing, highway hum. No music.
[[/AESTHETIC]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
Continue from @PREVIOUS_CLIP
WS, SLOW DOLLY BACK -> Cop paces slowly back to frame-left along the line of travelers -> [ACT] Cop keeps pineapple in both hands; travelers stare straight ahead without tracking his movement -> COP: "Is there anything else in the vehicle I should know about?"
SLOW PAN, R→L -> Scanning across the travelers' faces -> [ACT] Everyone remains silent; Robert clears his throat quietly without moving his head -> [SFX] Quiet throat clear, desert wind hum
MCU -> Robert facing left -> [ACT] Robert stands perfectly still, genuinely contemplating -> ROBERT: "No."
MCU -> Cop facing right -> [ACT] Cop glances down at the pineapple, back up at Robert, and releases a small, tired sigh -> COP: "Sir. A nod is not—" -> [ACT] Cop stops mid-sentence, shaking his head slightly
CU, LOCKED -> Close-up on the pineapple held in Cop's hands -> [ACT] A small fly lands on the pineapple's green crown, walks two steps, and stops; the hands remain perfectly still -> [SFX] Fly buzzing, low wind drone
MCU -> Lea standing frame-right -> [ACT] Lea remains with arms crossed, staring blankly at the middle distance -> LEA: "Last time it was a melon."
CU -> Cop facing right -> COP: "Last—" -> [ACT] Cop opens his mouth to speak, hesitates, and closes it. He slowly rotates the pineapple in both hands, inspects the base, then holds it steady again with a deep sigh
WS, LOCKED -> All five characters framed against the station wagon -> [ACT] Cop stands planted on the left with pineapple, travelers stand on the right, all perfectly motionless -> [ENV] Heat haze ripples over the dry asphalt
CU -> Mark facing left -> [ACT] Mark blinks once behind his glasses, maintaining absolute stillness as the wind gently stirs his hair -> [ENV] Soft rustle of dry weeds, distant highway hum
[</BRIEF>]
